protocol.authorization: Root explicitly authorized ONLY ten pending original projection jobs on dev15 GPUs0/6 after five bare original evaluator repeats.

scientific_review.interpretation: Original native Cube evaluation itself is not outcome-bitwise reproducible. Exact CPU pass-through contracts and bare-repeat evidence justify continuing the predeclared hypotheses, but do not prove zero wrapper effect. Current Cube comparisons remain exploratory due to environment repeat variation. Old failed exits are preserved and never relabeled successful.
scientific_review.scope: Only dependency review changes: same helper2e/model sources/cases/config/actions/objective as original projection plan; new output/spec paths. No algorithm or source change. First each slot runs its pending TwoRoom original replay; four bounded runs follow sequentially. Original other six slots and all old results/plan remain untouched.

limitations: Historical reference is fixed for all comparisons, never chosen from old/wrapped/bare outcomes. Case bootstrap conditions on two fixed training seeds and observed simulator realizations; it excludes training-seed population and environment repeat variance. Native LeWM and the proposed models differ in capacity/objective/recipe. No matched-capacity or new learning-method claim.
